Plot DV vs TIME with median and interval band

Source: R/nm_plot_dv.R
nm_plot_dv.Rd

Plot DV vs TIME with median and interval band

Usage

nm_plot_dv(
  data,
  y = c("DV", "DV_norm"),
  time_var = c("TIME", "TAD"),
  strat = NULL,
  ci_probs = c(0.05, 0.95),
  cmt = NULL,
  xlim = NULL,
  scales = c("linear", "log", "both"),
  blq_handling = c("show", "exclude", "keep"),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame from nm_read_csv().

y

Y variable: "DV" (default) or "DV_norm".

time_var

X variable: "TIME" (default) or "TAD" (time after dose, computed by nm_read_csv() when EVID is present).

strat

Name of a stratification column (e.g. "DOSE").

ci_probs

Quantiles of the interval band (default 90% interval, c(0.05, 0.95)).

cmt

CMT value(s) to keep (NULL = all).

xlim

X-axis limits c(min, max) (NULL = full range).

scales

"linear", "log" or "both" (side-by-side panels).

blq_handling

BLQ handling: "show" (grey crosses, default), "exclude" or "keep".

verbose

Print diagnostics (default TRUE).

Value

A ggplot (or a patchwork object if scales = "both").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
parsed <- nm_read_csv("data.csv", lloq = 0.5)
p <- nm_plot_dv(parsed$data, strat = "DOSE", cmt = 2, scales = "both")
print(p)
} # }
